propositions: The review bot computes per-call token usage (_usage dict with input/output/cache/request fields) but discards it instead of publishing to CloudWatch.
finalize.py reads _usage only for verify_requests count and never aggregates input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens across agent steps.
voter.py has an established best-effort boto3 error-metric pattern but no token-usage emitter wired to the vote path.

The bot must aggregate token usage from Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide steps (not Pass-1 finder, which is a deferred follow-up) into coverage.metrics and publish five CloudWatch metrics (input/output/cache_read/cache_write/total_tokens) with best-effort error handling.
Token metrics must be emitted after a successful vote without failing the review if CloudWatch/boto3 is unavailable, and logged as a greppable LLM_TOKEN_USAGE marker for host-probe fallback.
